outcome.implementation_scope: ECI service accountability, Environment owner-pass trace projection, and bounded response compaction.
outcome.implementation_change: When session readiness services are empty or unrecorded and an owner-pass trace exists, service_accountability now includes an environment_service_execution summary derived from the existing coherence-pass contract and trace. It links to the source trace by digest and carries scheduler decision coverage, scheduled/skipped totals, failure observation, result-record totals, and explicit unknown fulfillment, verification, and intervention-burden states.
outcome.verified_change: The final capability-intelligence module passes 159 tests; the vertical proof passes; the subsequent bounded ECI readback shows the service-accountability and owner-pass views share snapshot sequence 481 and matching digest da8be6012c3c0f79. The response remains partial and truncated while preserving the linked summary.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The projection is more connected and inspectable. No later independent agent activity establishes that it reduced reconstruction work or improved service quality.

improvement_relation.basis: The implementation reuses the existing owner-pass contract and trace, correlates them by the exact ambient-service-execution projection digest, and retains session, environment, and snapshot context in the surrounding service-accountability projection. Tests cover empty and absent readiness declarations, partial scheduler coverage, compact response behavior, and source-digest equality. The live readback shows a complete seven-pass scheduler decision set and exact result records without treating them as agent-need opportunities or verified fulfillment.
not_measured: cross-session recurrence of this projection gap
agent time or tool calls spent correlating the former separate views
whether agents discover or use the new relation
agent receipt, intervention-burden reduction, and downstream service quality
effectiveness across other ambient services or native-language adoption

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The live projection is one session and its event window is truncated.
The recorded owner-pass contract is an Environment scheduler scope; it is not a registry of all environmental service responsibilities.
Effectiveness remains unassessed until later independent activity shows how agents use this relationship.
